originalTitle: SpaceX's biggest bull sees valuation soaring above $10 trillion
simplifiedContent: An analyst at Raymond James, named Brian Gesuale, thinks very highly of SpaceX and thinks its value will increase significantly. He set a target price of $800, which means he believes the company's stock will go up a lot in the future. Gesuale predicts that SpaceX will make a huge amount of money, $5.2 trillion, by 2035, mostly because of its new artificial intelligence business. He thinks this AI business will become the main source of revenue for SpaceX as early as 2027. This matters because if Gesuale is right, it could be a good time for investors to buy SpaceX stock, as its value could go up a lot in the future.

originalTitle: As issues line up, many companies join pre-IPO placement queue
simplifiedContent: Some companies in India are raising money from investors before they list their shares on the stock market, which is called a pre-IPO placement. This is becoming more popular after a slow start to the year. By doing this, companies can get a sense of what they're worth and find important investors before going public. This helps reduce the risk of their initial public offering (IPO) not going well. It also gives big investors a chance to get in early and learn more about the company's value before it's available to the general public.

originalTitle: How to strengthen Indian rupee without a rate hike
simplifiedContent: The Indian Rupee has lost a lot of value compared to the US Dollar since early 2025. To help the Rupee, some measures were put in place to attract more investment and support the currency. The Reserve Bank of India has been actively involved in the foreign exchange market to help stabilize the Rupee. A new idea is being considered that could help reduce delays in foreign exchange transactions, which could also help keep the Rupee stable. This plan aims to make the Rupee stronger without changing interest rates, which is important because changing interest rates can have big effects on the economy.

originalTitle: Knack Packaging IPO listing date today. GMP, experts signal share debut at a decent premium in Indian stock market
simplifiedContent: Today, July 8, 2026, is the day when Knack Packaging's shares will start trading on the Indian stock market, specifically on the BSE and NSE exchanges. This means that people who bought shares of the company during its initial public offering (IPO) will now be able to sell them. Experts think that the shares will start trading at a slightly higher price than what people paid for them during the IPO, which is called a "premium". This premium is expected to be moderate, not extremely high. The company's share price will now be determined by the market, and investors will be able to buy and sell shares freely.

originalTitle: Amfi reshuffle signals market leadership shift as BSE enters large-cap club
simplifiedContent: A change has been made to how companies are grouped in the stock market, and this shows a shift in which companies are leading the market. Some companies that work with money, make power equipment, and build telecom infrastructure are now considered "large-cap", which means they have a high value. On the other hand, some companies that make medicine, provide healthcare, and make cars have been moved to a lower group called "mid-cap", which means their value is lower. This matters because it shows which types of companies are currently doing well and which are not. The BSE, a major stock exchange, is now also considered a large-cap company, which is a significant change.
